chapter: Growing up with jazz in Belfast
title: Traditional versus progressive in England, and the Graham Bell tour
summary: Whether English traditional players move on to modern styles, a Tuxedo parade he heard, and the touring Australian band.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
